name: LeSpell
description: Spellchecking text written by language learners is especially challenging because errors made by learners differ both quantitatively and qualitatively from errors made by already proficient learners. We introduce LeSpell, a multi-lingual (English, German, Italian, and Czech) evaluation data set of spelling mistakes in context that we compiled from seven underlying learner corpora. Our experiments show that existing spellcheckers do not work well with learner data. Thus, we introduce a highly customizable spellchecking component for the DKPro architecture, which improves performance in many settings.
reputation: Well-regarded within the learner-language and NLP spelling-correction community but relatively niche compared with large public benchmarks.
notes: Compiled from seven learner corpora—dataset reflects learner-specific error patterns and may not generalize to native-speaker errors; moderate size; primarily a non-LLM benchmark but applicable to modern sequence-editing models.
